title: One Pan Creamy Bacon Ranch Chicken and Gnocchi
ingredients: 1-2 pounds chicken breast, cut into 1-inch cubes
1-2 teaspoons Slap Ya Mama seasoning (for chicken)
3 tablespoons butter (if no bacon grease remains, for chicken)
more Slap Ya Mama seasoning, to taste
instructions: In a large skillet, cook 12 ounces chopped bacon over low-medium heat so it doesn't splatter. Once about halfway cooked, add the diced onion. Once cooked, remove bacon and onion from the pan and let drain on paper towels.
Cut 1-2 pounds chicken breast into 1-inch cubes. Season with about 1/2 packet ranch seasoning and 1-2 teaspoons Slap Ya Mama seasoning. Toss with 2 tablespoons corn starch.

If there's bacon grease left in the pan, cook the chicken in that. If not, add 3 tablespoons butter. Cook on medium-high for 3 minutes, then flip and cook another 3 minutes until cooked through. Remove chicken from pan.
In the same pan, add another tablespoon of butter if needed. Add 1 pound gnocchi and cook until slightly browned, about 4-5 minutes.

Add 3/4 cup low sodium chicken broth and 1 cup heavy cream. Season with the rest of the ranch seasoning and more Slap Ya Mama seasoning. Heat to a low simmer, then stir in 1/2-1 cup shredded Parmesan cheese. Cook a few minutes until thickened.
Add a couple handfuls of spinach. Once wilted, add the chicken and bacon back in and top with the bacon.
notes: Recipe extracted from the author's (Andrea) pinned first comment on the Facebook reel, not the video caption. Comment section had suggestions: some commenters said they'd skip the spinach, or substitute broccoli for it.
